summary.headline: Mercury’s Foundations in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological indications of Mercury and the Moon in foundational positions, including evening- and morning-side effects on kings, armies, public health, diseases, animals, ships, weather, and nobles. The discussion proceeds through Pisces, Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, and Capricorn, with calculations involving conjunctions, lunar motion, the Sun, and Mercury’s maximum elongation.
